notes: AGPC API Keys management 0.1.0-1. Exact administrative packages from reviewed canonical main CI, authenticated by the established archive key. The coordinator uses the existing approved CI account and target-labeled native authentication. The Voice owner preserves the existing credential UID/GID/mode and verifies the installed service-user Voice API start/close path through the existing Voice library without phone calls or caller audio. Native hidden prompts use the declared Zenity dependency. The owner pins the existing Voice runtime version; no daemon, policy grant, credential payload or runtime upgrade is included. Provider retirement requires a separate reviewed expiring binding and Admin API credential. Installation, target setup and independent fresh runtime acceptance remain separate; this release does not promote Core/All or establish whole-system readiness.
